title: A Special Baby Is Coming
traveler_why: Tonight is a promise spoken seven hundred years before it was kept, and Wren the Wonderer is the Traveler who marvels at a plan instead of trying to solve it.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she loves to wonder about Heavenly Father’s beautiful plans. In Wren’s world today: Wren saw her aunt getting ready for a new baby and wondered, “Isn’t it amazing how Heavenly Father plans good things before they even happen?” She thought about how He promised baby Jesus long ago too. Just like Isaiah wondered at the promise of the Prince of Peace, Wren marveled at Heavenly Father’s wonderful, hope-filled plans.
